cells.gaps: No source states adoption of the 2005 strategy by decree or by the minister: it has been found as finalised at a seminar in September 2005, and its targets ended in 2015. No successor sector policy is on record as adopted or in preparation, no text has been found, no report against it, and nothing on a body, a budget line or the last twelve months. It is not flagged lapsed because it is not held as adopted.
cells.note: Stratégie sectorielle des postes, télécommunications et TIC 2005: validated, never shown adopted, and its period ended in 2015, so under the step 5 ruling it is not in preparation and places nothing. A national digital strategy is held and systems.csv holds a development-plan instrument, which set the two flags and no stage.
